craft_notes: Sthāyin: turn-joy (Devī→Bhairava). Close: Unsurpassed. Rejected: one voice — killed: two kept; labhāmi (gain) kept vs vrajāmi (go).

lines: Tell me of her, god of gods, by whom to fullness I attain —
Hear, blessed Goddess: beyond all answering, the Unsurpassed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tāṃ me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ labhāmyaham | śṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaram

reads_against.argmap: Devī asks fullness (gaining, not going); Bhairava answers: hear — even of the answer, the unsurpassable.
c1_essence: Fullness asked (gaining); answer beyond answers promised.
